title: Evaluation artifact: An Evaluation of Reservation-Based Serving for Long-Horizon Agentic Workloads
description:
Complete evaluation artifact for the paper An Evaluation of Reservation-Based Serving for Long-Horizon Agentic Workloads: a pre-registered, negative-result evaluation of per-flow completion guarantees for long-horizon agentic LLM serving, against six equally tuned baselines on a discrete-event simulator.

Contains the evaluation specification frozen 2026-07-06 with its complete amendment log and integrity rulings; the simulator with 141 tests; the tuning harness with both tuning campaigns at the censored and corrected horizons; every run manifest including the quarantined pre-amendment set; the preliminary readouts with their superseded banners intact; the final readout and the analysis code that computes the verdict as a pure function of the manifest set; figure-generation code with one command per figure, each asserting agreement with the published numbers; and the paper source.

Nothing reported in the paper depends on an unreleased artifact. MANIFEST.sha256 covers every file and PROVENANCE.txt records the commit, date and final-grid commit the release was built from.

Licensing is split. Code, meaning sim/ and the paper build tooling, is Apache License 2.0. Documents and data, meaning the readouts, manifests, specification, paper text and figures, are Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. See LICENSE and LICENSE-DOCS.
